#### Background and Data {#sec-pmd-641}

[**Description of the Data**]{#sec-pmd-641-collection}

The response variable for this data set is the coefficient of thermal expansion for copper. The predictor variable is temperature in degrees kelvin. There were 236 data points collected.

These data were provided by the NIST scientist Thomas Hahn.

[**Software**]{#sec-pmd-641-software}

The analyses used in this case study can be generated using both Dataplot code and R code.<!-- XREF: Dataplot macro not migrated; source handbook/pmd/section6/pmd641.dp --> The R code reproduced throughout this case study follows NIST's own reference R script for it. The reader can download the data as a [text file](../../datasets/HAHN1.DAT).

[**Resulting Data**]{#sec-pmd-641-data}

```{r}
#| code-fold: true
#| message: false
library(tidyverse)

hahn <- read_table(
  here::here("datasets", "HAHN1.DAT"),
  skip = 25,
  col_names = c("temperature", "thermal_expansion")
)

hahn
```
